A.name: Procurement-led growth
A.description: Prioritize RFP automation, capability decks, and Tier 1 spend reporting.
A.trigger: RFP/procurement pipeline >= 20% AND ambition is growth or exit-grooming

B.name: Operational excellence
B.description: Prioritize event-day quality, no-show recovery, and premium recaps.
B.trigger: RFP < 20%, pain in ops/quality/no-shows, or default branch

C.name: Account expansion
C.description: Prioritize client retention, QBR prep, and buried expansion signals.
C.trigger: Retained clients >= 30 AND pain in retention/repeat-book

D.name: Talent-led differentiation
D.description: Prioritize supportive talent experience alongside operational wins.
D.trigger: Talent AI tolerance open AND active talent >= 500
